thread:
jamie: Heads-up: several onboarding templates started throwing import resolution errors in Bun/Deno after the exports refactor.

leo: Which refactor exactly?

jamie: We removed the legacy `./` fallback and added explicit subpath exports. Example: `import {createClient} from '@redwood/sdk-js/client'` fails with 404 on Deno deploy.

anya: Paste the exports?

jamie: "exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs"},"./client":"./dist/esm/client.mjs","./package.json":"./package.json"}

leo: Right — some runtimes do simple string matching and don’t honour conditional exports fully, so they fall back to `main` (CJS) and blow up in ESM envs.

ci-bot: CI: onboarding-templates  3 failing jobs (import-resolution). See: https://ci.redwood.ai/flow/6602

anya: We also missed generating per-subpath d.ts files. TypeScript consumers importing `@redwood/sdk-js/client` get no types -> compile errors during onboarding.

jamie: Auth/retry tests flaked too; looks like a lazy import in the client pulled a Node-only auth shim in edge builds.

leo: Quick fixes: re-introduce `./` index mapping to ESM, add `import`/`require` conditions not `node`, and add `exports.types` per subpath. Also add a CI job that runs resolution against Bun/Deno/Cloudflare.

anya: I'll wire up types generation and add `exports.types`. Jamie can revert the refactor for the patch release.

release-bot: Drafted patch release `@redwood/sdk-js@1.9.3-compat` to npm for canary tests.

jamie: Creating a tiny repro repo and a smoke test that runs `deno bundle`/`bun build` in CI.

leo: After patch, follow-up: doc blurb about exports/subpath pitfalls in GETTING_STARTED and add a sample using the top-level import only.

anya: Owners: jamie -> rollback + repro, leo -> CI resolution matrix, anya -> types + docs. Will sync tomorrow.

jamie: Thanks — prioritizing this; onboarding experience is first-class for us so we can't leave this flaky. :pray:
